messages:
Jenna L (Support): FYI — Auditor requested KMS/HSM rotation evidence and also flagged an API outage tied to a rotation window. They want exported logs, retention proof, and a short repro timeline. Anyone on rotation runbook?
Chris P (Security): Thanks. Can you paste the auditor's exact asks? Need to map to controls (LOG-02, KEY-03).
Jenna L (Support): Copy of auditor email: "Please provide key rotation records (who/when), access logs for keystore, TLS handshake failures, and any customer-facing incidents during rotations between 2025-06-01 and 2025-06-07. Also retention policy proof for audit logs and a sample exported bundle."
Auditor M. Jones: Also: we saw a billing alert referencing failed requests. Please include any correlated billing events and incident ticket IDs.
Emma R (SRE): Noted. On our side we have rotation job runs: 
```
2025-06-02T03:12Z rotate-key job-id: rk-443
2025-06-04T02:58Z rotate-key job-id: rk-449
```
We keep keystore access logs in the keystore cluster (retained 3 years). I can export an access-log slice and link to S3.
DevOps Bot: /export-logs --service keystore --from 2025-06-01 --to 2025-06-07 --type access,rotation,auth -> export-id: export-1975/ ready in 12m
Jenna L (Support): Auditor asked for chain-of-custody (who initiated rotation and approval evidence). We should include PR/approval IDs and the runbook exec trace.
Chris P (Security): Approvals: rotations triggered by infra-scheduled workflow. Approver group: key-admins@redwood. Approval records are in Vault audit and in PagerDuty runbook events. I'll pull the PR references and attach hashes.
Emma R (SRE): On the API outage: we had a spike in 503s at 2025-06-04T02:59Z that correlates with a keystore node restart. Short timeline: 
- 02:58 rotate-key started
- 02:59 one keystore pod OOM, restarted (k8s evicted)
- 02:59–03:04 elevated 503s across t3-runtime (avg latency +1.2s)
- 03:05 autoscale healed and prefix cache warmed
I'll include logs and the kube events. Minimal customer impact but billing alert triggered for retries.
Auditor M. Jones: For the exported bundle we need: rotation job logs, keystore access logs (UID correlation), kube events for the node, and any incident tickets + timelines. Also a brief statement on retention policy and where it's implemented.
Chris P (Security): Drafting a one-pager for the auditor: controls mapped, log retention config (S3 lifecycle + immutability flag), key rotation schedule, and incident timeline. ETA 2 business days.
Jenna L (Support): I'll coordinate delivering the export link and the one-pager. Emma — when export-id is ready can you upload to our secure auditor bucket and share link with read-only token? Mark as case-1975 in the object name.
Emma R (SRE): Will do. Export ready in ~10m. I'll attach kube events snippet and the minimal repro steps: 
1) start rotate-key job with sequence id
2) simulate pod memory pressure 100% on keystore-1
3) observe OOM eviction -> 503s in runtime -> autoscale recovery
(we won't run simulation in prod; steps are for internal repro doc)
DevOps Bot: export-1975 uploaded: s3://redwood-audits/case-1975/export-1975.tar.gz (auditor-read token: expires 2025-07-07)
Auditor M. Jones: Received. Quick clarifying Q: do you have a hash for the export bundle and a statement of who packaged it? Need chain-of-custody before accepting.
Chris P (Security): SHA256: 3b7f9a2d8f1e9d2c9b6a7e4c5d2f8a1b6c3d9e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1. Packaged by Emma R (SRE) per security packaging SOP (signed-off by Chris P). I'll add signature note to object metadata.
Jenna L (Support): I'll send this bundle + one-pager and timeline to the auditor and mark the ticket. Anything else?
Auditor M. Jones: That should cover the immediate ask. After review we might request a longer retention proof sample and the rotation policy doc. Thanks for the fast turn. :thumbsup:
Chris P (Security): One follow-up: I'll attach the KMS HSM manifest showing key IDs and rotation events (non-sensitive metadata only). Emma — pls confirm manifest upload.
Emma R (SRE): Manifest uploaded to same bucket as manifest-1975.json (read-only for auditor). Closing loop in 5m.
Jenna L (Support): Closing here — will post delivery confirmation once auditor ack's receipt.
